(months mind) o’leary, ballygarvan. pad spillane, ballinabearna. tim o’regan, ballygarvan. dave donovan, myrtle hill. john & pat o’keeffe, grannig. micheal o’leary, myrtle hill. bridie & john forde, tulligmore. philomena willers, ballinphellic. teresa & paddy ryan, ballygarvan. pat & bridget mccarthy, skibbereen. goggins hill 11.30am mass intentions: - missa pro populo mary barry murphy, goggins hill. michael condon, ballyleigh. john & joan o’sullivan, goggins hill. dan & ellen coleman, ballynagrumoolia. mary, richard & niamh lombard, rearour. mass times next week: - tuesday 27th: - ballygarvan 9.30am wednesday 28th: - goggins hill 9.30am thursday 29th: - ballyheada 9.30am friday 30th: - ballygarvan 9.30am adoration: - ballygarvan every friday after 9.30am mass . saturday 31st vigil ballyheada: - 7.00pm confession before mass. sunday 1st: - all saints ballygarvan 10.00am goggins hill 11.30am confession after sunday mass. confession after week day mass on request. we remember geraldine sherratt, (née duff), ballyleigh. william (willie) coleman, ballynoe who died during the week. we pray for their families neighbours and friends. ballinhassig parish newsletter for ballygarvan, ballyheada and goggins hill vol. 35 no. 7 sunday: october 25th, 2026 (thirtieth sunday in ordinary time ) as we gather and pray in our cemeteries mary o’hsubmits…. this saturday october 24th as we gather for prayers in two of the cemeteries of our parish, we reflect on the following :- lord, we come here today - to revere the memory of those whom you have called from this life, we come to the place where their remains were returned to the earth in the way of all flesh; earth to earth and dust to dust. here is where they were entrusted - into your hands, into your love. here is where they were given the final farewell, and prayers for a safe journey into your keeping. here is where we especially ask you - to bestow on them the joy of your peace, so that together with you in your eternal home, where this world of dust and ashes and the fragility of this life no longer hold sway, they will find eternal rest. amen. (christy kenneally) ballinhassig

readings october 6th gn 2:18-24. ps 127, 5. heb 2:9-11. mk 10:2-16. blessing of graves the annual prayers & blessing of the graves in the parish graveyards will take place as follows: (please note dates and times) saturday october 24th :- ballinaboy 5.30pm ; ballyheada 6.00pm sunday november 1st: - goggins hill after 11.30am mass sunday november 8th: - liscleary 2.00pm; killingley 3.00pm fr. sean will bless every grave while members of the funeral ministry team continue with prayers and the rosary. november offering envelopes are now available in the three churches. please return your envelope with your list of deceased loved ones on or before the opening of the novena mass. we have loved them in life, let us not forget them in death. mass for bereaved the annual parish mass for the bereaved will be held in ballyheada church on friday november 20th at 7.00pm. church choirs ballyheada church choir practice in ballyheada church on thursdays at 8.00pm. we invite interested singers or musicians to join the choir. it is not essential for singers to be able to read music. all welcome. goggin’s hill church choir would welcome singers and musicians to sing at 11.30am mass on sundays , with practice before mass . we would be delighted to hear from anyone in the community who could accompany us on the organ, even just occasionally. further details contact teresa
